On the chain

Real assets, real routes

Tokenized equities with live Uniswap v4 prices, plus the loudest Robinhood-chain memes. Every pack pulls from this set — pop a bubble to see what could drop.

Blue-chip stocks give the floor; memes give the variance. Some names show coming soon until they're tokenized / bridged on Robinhood Chain.

The odds

Rarity

Weighted, published odds. The rarest assets are the hardest to pull — and the ones that flex hardest on the timeline.

Simple

How it works

1

Connect

Any EVM wallet — Robinhood Wallet, MetaMask or Coinbase. Robinhood Chain adds automatically.

2

Choose

Pick a booster — AI, Mag7, Meme Moonshot, Index. Every pack shows its published odds.

3

Reveal

Rip it open. A provably-fair on-chain roll selects your asset live.

4

Own

The collectible you pull lands in your wallet. Self-custody, always.

Under the hood

How every opening works

No inventory. No IOUs. Every step happens on-chain — and ends with a real card in your wallet.

STEP 01

USDG in

Your payment enters the pack contract.

STEP 02

Verifiable randomness

A provably-fair VRF draw selects your asset.

STEP 03

Uniswap v4 swap

USDG swaps for the asset on-chain.

STEP 04

Real ERC-20 minted

A tokenized stock or meme, Chainlink-priced.

STEP 05

Settles to your wallet

The card is yours. Self-custody, always.
